ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which animals in the diagram are herbivores?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, with plants/producers at the bottom, including Plantain and Berries. The diagram uses arrows to show food relationships; there is an arrow connection between Rabbit and Plantain, and Grasshopper is also connected by arrows with plant materials such as Plantain/Berries. Reasoning: The question asks which animals are herbivores (plant-eating animals). Herbivores are animals that eat plants, so one should look for animals that obtain food from plant nodes. According to the connections from plants to animals in the diagram, Rabbit eats Plantain, and Grasshopper eats plant materials, so they are herbivores.
